pricing.fees: 4 legs x 0.65 USD per round trip

design_decisions_made_at_registration: entry_timestamp_binds_to_15:55:00_ET_quote_surface: the 10:10 import covers DTE 5-35 only while the playbook requires 21-45; the 15:55 surface covers DTE 5-60 and matches the close-basis convention of the PUT/WPUT index literature
exit_monitoring_uses_daily_15:55_quotes: profit-take/loss-cut/time-exit evaluated once daily at 15:55 with side-aware exit debit
monthly_tenor_bias_note: literature (verified 3-0) shows weekly rolling underperformed monthly; the 21-45 DTE band with 7-DTE time exit is the frozen compromise already in the playbook
entry_cadence: one candidate per underlying per entry-regime day; overlapping positions in the same underlying are not stacked (first-open blocks new entries until exit)

entry_regime.vix_bucket: low_or_mid point-in-time bucket required (frozen threshold policy contract)
entry_regime.crash_guard: no entry when point-in-time market-regime inputs mark crash regime

gates_for_validation_pass.tail_report_required: max drawdown, worst month, skew/kurtosis of trade P&L — reported, not gated, per the literature's drawdown-profile caveat

engine_requirement: a credit-spread replay harness with side-aware entry credit, daily exit monitoring, assignment/expiration fail-closed handling, and full denominator statuses per the playbook; to be implemented research-only before any scoring

interpretation.forward_bar_form_if_passed: suggestion-tracking paper-shadow only (operator decision 2026-07-08: no broker or paper-API execution; take-all vs operator-picks dashboards)
